Hanno Eco-Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-morimana-riverwatch/

Observe the creatures living in the Naguri River (Iruma River) in early autumn while the heat lingers. Enjoy fishing, learn about the connections between riverside creatures, and observe water quality indicator organisms.

【Fee】Adults ¥5,000 / Students ¥4,000 / Preschool children ¥2,500 (includes guide, insurance, materials)

【Capacity】15 people per session

【Guide】Forest Field School staff

【What to bring】Drinks, change of clothes, hat, lunch

【More information】Forest Field School website: https://morinomanabiya168.wixsite.com/website
